# FDG5109

> DO throw `ArgumentNullException` if a null argument is passed and the member does not support null arguments.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.8.2 Validating Arguments.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1062
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

CA1062 reports a parameter that is dereferenced without a null check: a member that does not support null and does not throw ArgumentNullException. It accepts any null check before the dereference, so a check that throws another exception or returns is not reported, although the text asks for ArgumentNullException (see FDG5073); it does not report an explicit interface implementation (see FDG5108). Whether a member supports null is otherwise not seen. CA1510 is not mapped: it only rewrites a check that already throws ArgumentNullException. CA1062 has no code fix; adding the check changes no signature.
